archetypes.name: dyn-launcher
archetypes.rationale: Stable runner, pointer, and bootstrap failure paths carry cross-step lifecycle risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new PID-keyed implement runner and Step 0 bootstrap failure behavior. Check that the pointer parsing avoids sourcing untrusted state, preserves argv, exports IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR, and fails closed when prerequisites are missing. Verify the updated prompt-side launcher contract stays consistent across skill prose and Python entrypoints. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
